content.rationale: One dispatcher: split the first word from the rest (S1-split), dispatch only a single lowercase word (S1-shape/D10), hand the rest on untouched (S1-args), refuse an unknown word by name (S1-refuse/D20) without running anything (S1-quiet), and stay additive (S1-extend/D23). It is generic over the table and the ambient context it is handed — both assembled at M-main — and it threads that context to the handler alongside the verb's own args, the dispatcher's share of the injected-context architecture (M-context-injection), and threads the handler's normal lines out under the output contract (M-output-return) — it produces refusals and lines, never renders either.
